# CellPay (full version)

> Pay or refill a US prepaid phone plan online with just the phone number, no carrier login. 15+ carriers, in English and Spanish. Service fee shown before you pay.

CellPay is an independent payment service, not affiliated with any carrier. Short index: https://www.cellpay.us/llms.txt

## How it works (all carriers)

1. Open the carrier page (English, or Spanish by adding /es before the path).
2. Enter the 10-digit phone number of the line to refill or pay.
3. Pick an amount or plan. Plans and prices load live from the carrier catalog and are shown before you pay.
4. Review the order summary: number, amount, service fee and total. The service fee is shown before you pay.
5. Pay with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Klarna, Cash App or Pay by Bank. Keep your confirmation.

## Common questions

- Do I need a carrier login or CellPay account? No. Guest checkout with just the phone number.
- Can I pay someone else's phone? Yes, with their 10-digit number. The charge goes on your payment method, not their account. Payments are final, so check the number.
- How fast does it post? Most payments post within minutes; it can take up to 30 minutes.
- Is there a fee? Yes, a service fee applies and is shown in the order summary before you pay. Taxes and fees can vary by location.
- Can I get a refund? Completed payments are final. If the carrier cannot add the refill, the payment is automatically refunded. Contact support@getcellpay.com with the phone number and details if a payment has not posted after 30 minutes.
- Auto Pay: optional, only if offered at checkout, never pre-checked; cancel anytime with "Unsubscribe From Autopay" on https://www.cellpay.us/faq.
- Support hours: Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM (EST), Saturday-Sunday 10:00 AM-4:00 PM (EST).
